function.name: guard_check
function.description: Ask the Semilla1 Guard (QIE) whether a payment would be allowed by the owner's policy. Read-only, costs nothing. Returns would_allow, reason and remaining_today_wei.

function.name: guard_pay
function.description: Ask the Semilla1 Guard to pay. The guard enforces per-tx cap, daily cap, allow-list, cooldown and pause; a denied attempt is recorded on-chain as a DENY Decision event and pays nothing.
